task: Independent read-only review of w009 naming accessibility controls and no-font-leading physical-pixel text metric

findings.finding: The naming Form does not explicitly preserve the keyboard on scroll. Apple documents automatic dismissal for non-TextEditor scrollable content. The presenting library sets interactively before its sheet modifier; propagation into this editor cannot be assumed. At AXXXL a scroll to Save or Cancel can dismiss the keyboard and fail the new explicit keyboard-presence assertions.
findings.recommendation: Explicitly set scrollDismissesKeyboard(.never) on this Form if live-keyboard reachability is the intended contract, or establish inherited behavior with native evidence.
